response.sql: WITH award_winners AS (SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, p.bats FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM award_winners) SELECT bats, COUNT(*) as winner_count, COUNT(*) / CAST((SELECT total_count FROM totals) AS FLOAT) as share FROM award_winners GROUP BY bats ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
